content:
**Why late (217 days past due; planned end 2026-02-26, today 2026-10-01)**
- WO-2026-00048 (Pump Mounting Bracket Assembly, 60 qty) is stopped with 0 produced; the first job card JC-2026-00142 (Fastener Assembly, ASSY-01) has never started — 224 days waiting.
- **Blocking causes (no ready date known):**
  - Subcontracts never sent, both still in draft: SCO-2026-00076 (vendor Supriya Rathi, expected 2026-03-19) and SCO-2026-00030 (Shreeji Powder Coating, expected 2025-08-12).
  - Two engineering changes pending: ECO-2026-00064 (under_review, "switch to new") and ECO-2026-00012 (draft, "continue old"), both about material shortages on related lines.
- Contributing: order stopped with no recorded reason; two schedule-subcontract-pending flags; downtime on CNC-02 Haas VF-2 VMC (456 min, "other" — tap wrench rework, Aug 2025) and 45 min tool-change downtime on ASSY-01 since 2026-07-03.
- No cost has been recorded on the order (expected and actual both 0), so no variance can be given.

**What it blocks**
- No other work orders may be affected (reverse BOM walk found none).
- Directly tied sales order (recorded exposure): **SO-2026-00092, Kirloskar Pumps Ltd, delivery 2026-03-07, ₹494,476.64, confirmed and undelivered.** Customer impact is flagged "known".

**Rescheduling**
- Nothing can be rescheduled from this seat. The platform's proposal returns no committable date ("blocked by an event with no known date"), not writable by me because of the two draft subcontracts and the two pending ECOs. Moving the dates would only paper over those blockers — they need a person: purchasing to send SCO-2026-00076 / SCO-2026-00030, and engineering to decide ECO-2026-00064 / ECO-2026-00012. I could not raise an escalation from this seat (no escalate tool is available here), so please route those records manually.

**Not visible to me**
- Nothing was flagged as hidden for this seat; everything above came from live records.
